[center][font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=4]Finished the story and feeling like every day is a loop? Bored of repeater replaying the same event again and again?[/size][/font][/center]
[center][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]This mod adds an infinite number of dynamic, unique events for every NPC[/size][/font][/center]
[center][font=Comic Sans MS]
[youtube]RA9UJD_iWeY[/youtube][/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4][i]With the power of Smartphone, no two events are ever the same. They will deeply reflecting the actual conversations and relationships you've built with the townsfolk.[/i][/size][/color][/font]


[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]Key Features[/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Invite Anyone, Anytime: You can invite any NPC out for a special event. Want to take Abigail for a picnic this afternoon? Send her a text![/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Truly Unique Experiences: Are these just recycled vanilla cutscenes? No. Every single event is uniquely generated based on your ongoing relationship and chat history with that specific NPC.[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Endlessly Replayable: You can invite the same NPC out as many times as you want. The events will evolve as your friendship grows![/size][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=4]Multiple Event Types: Currently includes Picnics, Campfires, Birthday Parties, and Dining Out.[/size][/color][/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]Smartphone [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46248]>>> here[/url][/size][/color][/font]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]Smartphone is your central hub for scheduling events and building relationships. The more you text and converse with an NPC through the Smartphone, the higher the quality and personalization of your UEE events will be.[/color][/font][/size]

[font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][color=#00ff00]Usage limit and more:[/color][/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]This mod costs me [b][u][i]REAL MONEY[/i][/u][/b] for every event generated. For me and other fellow players, please use it responsibly.[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]To help balance the costs, you have limited usage that reset each in-game day. To bypass this limitation, you can get and use your own OpenAI API key, which means you will be paying for your own usage.[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][b][u][i]HIGHLY RECOMMENED:[/i][/u][/b] It is very easy and cheap to use your own key. You will no longer face daily limits and will have a much better overall experience. See instruction [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4389][b]IMPROTANT: GET YOUR OWN KEY[/b][/url][/color][/font][/*]
[/list]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]Compatablility:[/size][/color][/font][/left]
[left][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]Multiplayer: Fully supported.[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]Custom NPCs: Fully supported for SVE and RSV. Partially supported for VMV, SBV, Zuzu, and Luna - Astray. Other custom NPCs are functional but require manual customization for the best quality (see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4390]instruction[/url]).[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]Mobile and Split-screen: Not tested. Split-screen will likely not work.[/color][/font][/*]
[/list][/left]

[left][list]

[center][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]Your support here will help keep that day far away—or ensure it never comes at all![/color]
